parsed.rationale: The subtask is to identify the specific stock to monitor its performance. The 'Crypto Arbitrage Trading - Get coin price difference' API provides real-time price data for a specific coin, which directly relates to monitoring stock/coin performance. It requires a 'name' parameter that can be bound to the specific stock/coin to monitor. Other finance APIs are either credit card prediction or social sentiment APIs that do not directly provide real-time stock performance data. Thus, this API best satisfies the subtask intent.
